card.title: Approve the Cover Story
card.instruction: Get someone to endorse an explanation that protects the plan, reputation, or people involved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you back 'collecting chairs' when the caretaker asks why we opened the props cupboard? We need him to lend us the hall again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Checking for folding stools, then. Can you back that?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you admit you borrowed his key.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Borrowed his key to check for extra seating. Will you sign the hall request with me?

mechanism: A negotiates B's endorsement of a protective explanation for opening a cupboard to preserve hall access.
confusable: Unlike explaining innocence directly, A must secure another person's backing for the agreed account.
comparison: The hall applicant asks a co-signature after physical plausibility and key-use objections; the newsletter scene negotiates public wording.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
